title: Meta’s Muse AI can create custom ‘spaces’ for the version of the app you need right now

llm_summary: Meta’s Muse AI now lets users build “spaces”—mini, app‑like experiences tailored to whatever they need at the moment. With a simple prompt, Muse can generate a custom interface for things like a shopping hub, school dashboard, music tracker, trivia game, and more, all of which you can use directly inside the Muse app. This new feature turns the AI assistant into a rapid‑prototyping tool for personal, on‑the‑fly
